content: Dibooranne Baraaqe
Ehuudey hayqqidaappe guye Isra7eele asay GODAA sinththan zaareththidikka iita miish ooththides.
Hessa gishshas GODAY Haxoore geetettiza katamaan kawotida Kanaane kawo Yaabines istta aaththi immides; iza olanchchata kaaleththiza Sisaari Haroshe-Hagoye geetettiza kataman dees.
Yaabiney biratappe oosettida uddufun xeetu para-gaareti izas diza gishshassinne izi Isra7eele asaa nam7u tammu layth kumeth keehi un7eththida gishshas istti maado demmanaas GODAAKKO waassida.
He wode Laapidota machcha nabe Dibooray tinbite yootizaara Isra7eele deraa pirdiza daanna.
Izakka Efreeme deren bolla gezzen, Eraama katamaappenne Beetele katamaappe giddon diza Diboora zamba garsan uttada pirdawus; Isra7eele asay ba yo7o pirdisanaas izikko yees.

Issi gallas Diboora Abino7aame naa Baraaqe Niftaaleme biittan diza Qaadeese katamappe kiittada xeygisadus; «GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay nena, ‹Niftaaleme zareppenne Zaabiloone zareppe tammu shii as ekkada Taaboore zumaa bolla keza.
Yaabine olanchchata kaaleththiza Sisaara para-gaaretanne olanchchata ekkidi Qisoone shaafan nenara ola gayttanaas yaana mala tani iza denththeththana; tani iza nees aaththa immana› gi azazees» gadus.
Baraaqeykka izis, «Neni tanara biikko tani baana; neni tanara bontta aggiko tanikka biikke» gides.

Dibooraykka, «Ero, buussaa ta nenara baana; gido attiin GODAY Sisaara maccassa kushen aaththi immana gishshas ta buussay nees bonchcho gidenna» gadus; hessafe guye Dibooray dendada Baraaqera olas Qaadeese badus.
Baraaqey Niftaalemenne Zaabiloone zareta Qaadeese xeygiin tammu shii asay iza kaalli kezides; Dibooraykka izara badus.
He wode Qenaawe dere as Heebere geetettizayssi Muse bollo Hobaabe nayta Qenaawe dere asappe shaakettides; histtidi Qaadeesekko shiiqidi Zanaanimen gita wola garsan ba dunkaane tokkides.
Abino7aame naa Baraaqey Taaboore zuma bolla bidayssa Sisaari siyidi,
Sisaarikka biratappe oosettida uddufun xeetu para-gaaretanne banara diza olanchchata ubbaa xeygisidi Haroshe-Hagoyeppe Qisoone shaafa shiishshides.
Dibooray Baraaqe «Denda! Hekko hach GODAY Sisaara ne kushen aaththi immiza gallassa. Beya! GODAY neeppe sinththati bees» gadus; Baraaqey tammu shii asaa kaaleththidi Taaboore zuma bollafe wodhdhides.
GODAY Sisaara iza para-gaareta ubbaanne iza olanchchata ubbaa qara giththa mashshan Baraaqe sinththafe baqatissides; hessa gishshas Sisaari ba para-gaareppe wodhdhidi tohora baqatides.
Baraaqeykka Sisaara para-gaaretanne olanchchata Haroshe-Hagoye gakkanaas yedeththides; Sisaara olanchchatappe issaadeyka attontta ubbayka giththa mashshan wurida.

He wode Haxoore kawo Yaabinessinne Qenaawe dere as Heebere zereththata giddon lo7o gaytoteththi diza gishshas Sisaari tohon baqatidi Qenaawe dere as Heebere machchiyo Ya7eeli dunkaane giddo woxxi gelides.
Ya7eela Sisaara mokkanaas kezada, «Ta godawu, gela; haa gela; yayyofa» gadus; izi dunkaane giddo izikko geliin iza ba bullukkon kamma qottadus.
Sisaari, «Tana saamees; uyiza guuththa haath immarkkii!» gides; maath otoppe tiga ushshadus; histtada Sisaara iza zaara kamma qottadus.
Hessafe guye izi izo, «Dunkaaneza pengen eqqa; Ay asikka yiidi, ‹Hayssan asi dizee?› giidi nena oychchiko, ‹Baawa› ga» gides.

Sisaari keehi daaburda gishshas dhisko seerides; histtiin Heebere machchiya Ya7eela qoyxenne dunkaane dhishke ekkada loddara izakko shiiqadus; dhishkezakka hayththa corcoron essada duge biittara sikka dhishkiin Sisaari hayqqides.
Baraaqey Sisaara koyishe yiin Ya7eele iza mokkanaas kare kezada, «Haa ya; neni koyza addeza tani nena bessana» gadus; izira dunkaane giddo gelidi Sisaara hayththa corcoron
dhishkey dhishekkettiin iza ahay biitta bolla porccu gi dizayssa be7ides.
He gallas Xoossi Isra7eele asay Kanaane kawo Yaabine xoonana mala ooththides.
Isra7eele asay Kanaane kawo Yaabine bolla minni minni biidi wurseththan iza dhayssides.

footnotes.text: Hayththa corcoron: Hayththa corcoron gizayssi issi issi bagga gamoththo qaalan hayththa qorqonto geetettees.
